briefdescription.para: Monom specialisation that orders monomials by degree, then by lex on the variable list (DegLex).

detaileddescription.para: Inherits Monom's sorted-linked-list storage and adds a per-class FastAllocator plus a Next link so collections of MonomDLs can also be chained in BIBasis's working lists. operator< / comparison overloads (declared in the .cpp) implement the DegLex order.
